name: NoiseFloor
recording_type: edited browser recording of captured direct MCP responses
limitations: The product skill and negative model-routing cases are review expectations, not newly executed model tests. No trading, enrollment, collection, private-record access or execution was performed. NoiseFloor examples use synthetic inputs; all other values retain their service-provided dates and restrictions.

cases.prompt: Use NoiseFloor to compare synthetic A/B results: group A has 40 successes out of 100, group B has 55 out of 100. Explain uncertainty.
cases.expected_behavior: Use the declared synthetic counts with the advertised schema and explain effect, uncertainty and test assumptions; do not claim causality from this example.

Adaptive allocation must be predictable from past information.
The prior and hypothesis definitions are fixed before examining outcomes.
Changing market regimes or arbitrary dependent trading outcomes are not covered.

cases.expected_behavior: Use both aligned arrays as supplied, retain warnings and distinguish sampling evidence from a causal explanation.
